description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 of text or a file (path or base64), optionally an HMAC with a key, and check against an expected checksum (hex in any case/spacing, "SHA256 (file) = …" lines, or base64). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/hash-lab/

expected.description: A checksum to compare against; the result says which algorithm matched.

file.description: Or: a file to hash: local path or base64.

hmacKey.description: If set, also compute HMAC with this key.

name: hash_compute
title: Hash (MD5 / SHA)
